title: Buttery Russian Fideo Pilaf
description: A unique Japanese-inspired pilaf dish combining the flavors of Russia and the Mediterranean, made with fideo, pilaf, and a hint of buttery goodness.

ingredients.name: Fideo
ingredients.notes: Break into shorter lengths for even cooking

ingredients.name: Pilaf
ingredients.notes: Use Japanese-style pilaf for an authentic taste

ingredients.name: Lightly Butter
ingredients.notes: Unsalted, melted butter for added richness

ingredients.name: Russian Dill
ingredients.notes: Chopped fresh dill for added flavor

instructions: 1. Heat 1 tsp of oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
2. Add fideo and cook, stirring frequently, until lightly toasted (3-4 minutes).
3. Add pilaf and cook, stirring frequently, until heated through (2-3 minutes).
4. In a small bowl, whisk together melted butter, soy sauce, and chopped dill.
5. Pour the butter mixture over the fideo-pilaf mixture and stir to combine.
6. Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, stirring frequently, until the flavors have melded together.
8. Serve hot, garnished with additional dill if desired.
